slots.node05.text: Automated matching clears intercompany balances every day instead of at period end, which removes most of the manual reconciliation effort. Earlier review moves controller checks to the point of posting, so errors are fixed while they are cheap rather than found on day nine. Together the two changes free controllers to analyze results instead of chasing status.
